card.name: Dosing-section words in drug labels
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or digits inside dosing and combination-therapy sentences in drug labels, such as 'in' after 'monotherapy or', or the '2' in a section cross-reference.

modes.label: Linking word in dosing text
modes.description: A short word such as in, on, and or is that links a drug to a combination partner or a starting dose.
modes.example: OLUMIANT may be used as monotherapy or<< in>> combination with methotrexate or other

modes.label: Digit in dose or section number
modes.description: A digit within a treatment duration or a cross-reference to a Dosage and Administration section.

modes.label: Inside brand or drug names
modes.description: A piece of a brand name or a drug-class term in a dosing sentence.
